one_liner.zh: 为 DSH 提供可编辑 PowerPoint 制作技能与 PPTAgent 工具。
one_liner.en: Adds editable PowerPoint authoring skills and PPTAgent tools to DSH.

local: Node.js 22 or later; launcher supports Linux and macOS. PPTAgent runtime dependencies require explicit setup.

skipped: Remaining bundled skill implementations, scripts, binaries, and tool modules outside the lite review scope

completeness.reason: The DSH provider exposes bundled authoring skills and a CLI, while broad tool implementations were not reviewed.

code.reason: The provider and launcher have a small, clear structure with explicit platform and command handling.

docs.reason: The skill documentation describes authoring, review, setup, and delivery workflows.

maintenance.reason: The repository has two commits in the listed history.

tests.reason: Test files are present, but this lite review did not inspect their coverage or run them.

quality.notes: C-lite review; quality scores are conservative and based only on files read.
